# The Sovereignty of Good

*[Iris Murdoch](../philosophers/iris-murdoch.md) · 1970 · *The Sovereignty of Good**

A collection of three essays: "The Idea of Perfection" (1964), "On 'God' and 'Good'" (1969) and "The Sovereignty of Good over Other Concepts" (1967). Against Oxford moral philosophy and its focus on choice, [Murdoch](../philosophers/iris-murdoch.md) sets out an ethics of attention and a Platonic-inspired Good.
